snippet.title: Virtual Skate - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at gameplay and more from Virtual Skate in this trailer for the upcoming multiplayer physics-based VR skateboarding game, where your hands control your feet. Virtual Skate will coming to Early Access on Steam VR and Meta on August 21, 2025. In Virtual Skate, skate with your friends and then film it, with Virtual Skate's Filmer Mode you can rewind time and hold a camera to record your best tricks or goofy moments. Virtual Skate also features obstacle courses inspired by old shows like Unbeatable Banzuke and Ninja Warrior.
